Outlets Offer Tips on Reusing Household Waste Products

Multiple Hindi news outlets provided practical advice on reusing common household waste items. Aaj Tak detailed methods for using lemon peels to enhance facial appearance. News18 Hindi offered suggestions for repurposing coconut shells to beautify gardens. Both outlets presented these tips as ways to avoid discarding useful materials.
